plan.analysis: Inclusion is the failing class (recall 0.27, 136/179 missed) and the misses are overwhelmingly small (median 33.7px vs 90.5px train median; low-size tertile recall 0.14). Round 2's inclusion plan used scale 0.6-1.4 (too big) and uniform weighting, so it only nudged recall up. The missed inclusions look like small dark vertical blobs/streaks and a few speckled clusters, matching sources 11, 106, 150, 297, 50, 131. Patches (recall 0.70) and scratches (0.68) are decent but still miss small/low-contrast instances (median missed 49.6 and 39.1px), so keep small-scale prefer_small pastes, with thin bright-line scratch sources matching the missed thin lines.
plan.rationale: Shift inclusion to the scale band that actually matches its missed size (0.3-0.7, prefer_small) using compact-blob sources, and give it the largest share (30) since it has 136 misses and is far below the others; cumulative 75 stays under the 105 cap and near the ~80 diminishing-return zone. Patches and scratches keep small-scale prefer_small pastes (10 each) to cover their small/low-contrast misses without starving the shared detector; scratch sources restricted to thin bright lines matching the missed thin scratches.
